summary: Fixed the usage meter disappearing and manual compaction failing in gizmo. The meter now always renders (with an empty bar and the model's context window as fallback) via a new server-side `#emitUsageSnapshot` that re-emits the last known usage on client attach, and `configureCompaction` now caps `keepRecentTokens` at 16k so pi's cutter can always find a cut. Protocol schemas, the UI store's AgentModel, and tests were updated and all relevant suites pass.
decisions: Cap gizmo-managed compaction at `keepRecentTokens = 16_000` in `configureCompaction` because pi's estimator only counts message content chars/4 (no system prompt or tool schemas), so mapping 5% of a 1M-token window to 50k tokens made manual compact return 'session too small' on real 84k-token sessions.

Re-emit the latest usage snapshot (with `contextWindow`) from the server on client attach via a new `#emitUsageSnapshot`, instead of relying solely on assistant-message-end events, so the meter appears on new sessions, reconnects, and post-compaction.
Make `#emitUsageSnapshot` defensive with `typeof manager.getBranch !== 'function'` after test fakes lacked `getBranch`; the change is also general robustness.
Always render `UsageMeter` in `Composer.svelte` when a session is open, falling back to `emptyUsage(store.model?.contextWindow)`, rather than only when a `session.usage` event has arrived.
Add optional `contextWindow` (non-negative integer) to the protocol's `agentModelOptionSchema` and `agentModelCatalogSchema` so the server can report and the UI can use the model's window.
Compute and include `percent` in `usageView` so the UI can show a 0–100 percentage alongside the bar fraction.
errors: First `edit` call on `packages/protocol/src/index.ts` failed with 'Could not find edits[1]' because the oldText for the second edit used 4 tabs while the actual `current` object fields are indented with 5 tabs; verified via `sed ... | cat -A` and retried with the correct 5-tab indentation, after which 2 blocks were replaced.

`vitest` run for `pi-agent-service.test.ts` initially showed 7 failures because `#emitUsageSnapshot` called `manager.getBranch()` on test fakes that don't implement it; fixed by guarding with `typeof manager.getBranch !== 'function'`, after which all 7 tests passed.
